title: Jared Kushner meets Hamas on Mideast trip to push Gaza deal
summary_full: The president's son-in-law and envoy is expected in Jerusalem on Monday for talks with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who last week rejected the Trump-backed 15-point plan.
